# Unused-objects baseline for the Adventure Works Sales sample.
#
# Distilled from target/adventure-works-unused-analysis.csv (an external
# unused-objects analysis export over the same model in samples/), one object
# per line:
#
#   <ripbi-type>\t<table>\t<object name>\t<expected chain>
#
# expected chain: "orphan"  — externally marked Unused (ripbi: empty used_by)
#                 "chained" — externally marked Used by unused (ripbi: every
#                             consumer itself unused)
# The E2E test in tests/adventure_works.rs asserts every line is a ripbi
# finding with the matching chain shape, that no live object is flagged, and
# that the only extra findings are the dead 'Time Intelligence'
# field-parameter cluster (table, partition, its 10 calculation items), which
# nothing anywhere references.
column	Customer	City	chained
column	Customer	Customer	chained
column	Customer	Customer ID	orphan
column	Customer	Postal Code	chained
column	Customer	State-Province	chained
column	Date	Fiscal Quarter	chained
column	Date	Fiscal Year	chained
column	Date	Full Date	orphan
column	Date	Month	chained
column	Date	MonthKey	orphan
column	Product	Color	orphan
column	Product	List Price	orphan
column	Product	SKU	orphan
column	Product	Standard Cost	orphan
column	Reseller	City	chained
column	Reseller	Country-Region	chained
column	Reseller	Postal Code	chained
column	Reseller	Reseller	chained
column	Reseller	Reseller ID	orphan
column	Reseller	State-Province	chained
column	Sales	Extended Amount	orphan
column	Sales	Order Quantity (base)	chained
column	Sales	Product Standard Cost	orphan
column	Sales	Unit Price	orphan
column	Sales	Unit Price Discount Pct	orphan
column	Sales Order	Sales Order Line	chained
column	Sales Territory	Country	chained
column	Time Intelligence	Time Intelligence	chained
hierarchy	Customer	Geography	orphan
hierarchy	Date	Fiscal	orphan
hierarchy	Reseller	Geography	orphan
hierarchy	Sales Order	Sales Orders	orphan
hierarchy	Sales Territory	Sales Territories	orphan
measure	Sales	Average Sales per Order	orphan
measure	Sales	Order Quantity	orphan
measure	Sales	Sales MTD	orphan
measure	Sales	Sales PY	orphan
measure	Sales	Sales QTD	orphan
measure	Sales	Sales YTD	orphan
measure	Sales	Sales YoY	orphan
measure	Sales	Sales YoY %	orphan
measure	Sales	Sales by Due Date	orphan
measure	Sales	Sales by Order Date	orphan
measure	Sales	Sales by Ship Date	orphan
